items.title: Delhi court says Sharjeel Imam violated interim bail condition by interacting with media
items.summary: A Delhi court on Saturday said that Sharjeel Imam violated his interim bail condition in the Delhi riots conspiracy case by interacting with the media. However, Additional Sessions Judge Sameer Bajpai of Karkardooma courts said he was not cancelling Imam's bail since he has to surrender by today evening. The Court had granted Imam bail for seven days from October 4 to October 10 to attend the wedding functions of his cousin brothers. One of the conditions imposed in the interim bail order was that Imam must not come in contact with the media or use social media. Special Public Prosecutor (SPP) Madhukar Pandey appeared for the prosecution and argued that Imam violated this condition. He relied on videos uploaded on YouTube and social media platform X to argue that Imam was present in a room when his brother gave an interview to news agency ANI. Pandey also referred to the ANI videos in which Sharjeel Imam was sitting in his living room, talking to people present in the room. Pandey said that such a video could not have been shot without Imam’s knowledge. Advocate Talib Mustafa appeared for Imam and contended that he had neither interacted with any journalist nor given an interview.
